# Allowed roots resolve from the caller, and comma-containing roots stay literal.
mkdir caller
cd caller
exec ctx context --project ../bundle --ticket ticket.md --allow-source ../docs,extra --allow-source ../other
! stderr .
stdout '"complete":true'
stdout 'Comma directory content'
stdout 'Other directory content'
stdout '"kind":"spec"'
stdout '"kind":"context"'
cmp ../docs,extra/guide.md ../original.md

# An environment variable cannot authorize a directory.
env ALLOW_SOURCE=../docs,extra
env CTX_ALLOW_SOURCE=../docs,extra
exit 1 ctx context --project ../bundle --ticket ticket.md
stdout '"complete":false'
stdout '"traversalComplete":true'
stdout 'source_outside_scope'
! stdout 'Comma directory content'

# Invalid allowed roots are invocation errors.
exit 2 ctx context --project ../bundle --ticket ticket.md --allow-source ''
! stdout .
stderr 'nonempty'
exit 2 ctx context --project ../bundle --ticket ticket.md --allow-source ../absent
! stdout .
stderr 'allowed source'
exit 2 ctx context --project ../bundle --ticket ticket.md --allow-source ../original.md
! stdout .
stderr 'allowed source'

# Authorizing the external file's directory does not permit it as a ticket.
exit 1 ctx context --project ../bundle --ticket ../docs,extra/guide.md --allow-source ../docs,extra
stdout 'source_outside_scope'
! stdout 'Comma directory content'

-- bundle/ticket.md --
# Ticket
## Spec
[guide](../docs,extra/guide.md)
## Context
[other](../other/context.md)
-- docs,extra/guide.md --
# Comma directory content
-- original.md --
# Comma directory content
-- other/context.md --
# Other directory content
